description: This file defines the GrantFactory class within the OAuth2 client library, responsible for creating and managing different OAuth2 grant types (auth grants). It includes methods for registering, retrieving, and validating grant classes, and converting grant names into class names.

classes.name: GrantFactory
classes.description: A factory class for managing OAuth2 grant types, allowing registration, retrieval, and validation of grant classes.

methods.name: setGrant
methods.description: Register a specific grant instance with a name in the factory.

methods.name: getGrant
methods.description: Retrieve a grant instance by name, registering a default grant if not already registered.

methods.name: registerDefaultGrant
methods.description: Automatically generate a class name from the grant name and register it as the default grant.

methods.name: isGrant
methods.description: Determine whether a given class is a subclass of AbstractGrant.

methods.name: checkGrant
methods.description: Check if a class is a valid grant, throwing an exception if not.
